name: E5_4_indicbertv2_emotion_tuned
description: Stage 2, pre-registered test: IndicBERT v2 at the encoder LR chosen on validation in E5.2 (filled in by scripts/e5_tune.py; null until then). Equal budget for both encoders: up to 8 epochs with early stopping (patience 2) on validation emotion macro-F1, fp16 autocast, batch 16, same head and head LR, three encoder LRs each. Added because every E4.1 and E4.4 run peaked at its last (third) epoch.
